items.title: Machine Learning for Earth Observation & Climate
items.description: Applying regression, classification, deep learning, and neural networks to large-scale Earth observation and environmental data for predictive modeling and pattern extraction.

items.title: Climate Forcings using DAMIP Project
items.description: Investigating greenhouse gas (GHG) vs. natural forcings using Detection and Attribution Model Intercomparison Project (DAMIP) experiments.

items.title: CMIPs Projects especailly CMIP6 & CMIP7
items.description: Evaluating multimodel ensembles, historical temperature & precipitation simulations, future projection scenarios, and model systematic biases across regional scales.

items.title: Climate Extremes & Heatstress
items.description: Analyzing extreme precipitation and temperature anomalies, indices, and compound events using tools such as Climpact, Tidyextreme and advanced statistical metrics.

items.title: Uncertainty & Statistical Downscaling
items.description: Developing and using bias-correction workflows, statistical downscaling, post-processing methods, and quantifying model uncertainties in precipitation and temperature.

items.title: Geospatial Data Analysis & Remote Sensing
items.description: Processing multidimensional vector and raster datasets, using R (sf, terra, RGEE), Python (xarray, rasterio), and QGIS.
